verify_note: Delete: the story is about the Net Promoter Score (0-10 'would you recommend' question, promoters/passives/detractors). NPS was introduced by Reichheld in a 2003 Harvard Business Review article and in The Ultimate Question (2006), ten years after The Loyalty Effect (1996). It is not in the book the story is attributed to, so the central topic cannot be tied to The Loyalty Effect.
